title: JILIAAN’s “Love Like a Movie” turns heartache into something beautiful
htmlContent:
JILIAAN's debut single, "Love Like a Movie" captures that some love stories feel like they're straight out of a classic movie. This beautiful ballad has a feeling of deep emotion. Inspired by the works of composer Chopin, the song blends classical music with modern pop, creating a personal and cinematic style.

"Love Like a Movie" captures the bittersweet feelings that come with change. JILIAAN's powerful voice floats over rich, soothing strings, expressing the sadness of leaving a loved one behind. This song captures movement both in terms of physical distance and emotional connection. It celebrates the lasting bonds that can survive no matter the distance. There's a strength in its sadness, a beauty in its yearning, and a sense that this is only the beginning of a larger story.

https://open.spotify.com/track/4fj0rxUfbQyQV22DVEvfyI?si=WAvtgH3BTPOvf0v-Y7q0oA

The first taste of JILIAAN's upcoming debut EP, "Love Like a Movie," hints at an artist who isn't afraid to mix vulnerability with brilliance. JILIAAN is creating a world where the elegance of classical music meets the emotional pulse.
